subject: MAP: performance artifacts (TTFT, concurrency, throughput) — packaging + exec readout
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@cobalt.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: performance artifacts (TTFT, concurrency, throughput) — packaging + exec readout

Hi Ellen / team,

Per our MAP milestone for the close next week I’m attaching the initial performance artifact bundle covering the runs we discussed: TTFT (time-to-first-token), steady-state throughput at target QPS, and concurrency profiling. Attachments in this message: benchmark_results_v1.csv (raw per-run CSV), MAP_Perf_Pack_v1.pptx (slide summary for your stakeholders), ttft_concurrency_summary.pdf (two-page technical appendix).

Quick notes:
- TTFT: median 120ms for base samples at seq_len=128, 95th=240ms (see slide 3).
- Throughput: 420 tokens/sec per GPU at 8 concurrent streams (avg payload 64 tokens).
- Concurrency: linear scaling to 48 concurrent requests across three GPUs before queuing sensitivity increased; see concurrency chart in the PDF.

Ask: can you confirm this format is what your SRE/procurement needs for the MAP artifact checklist? If so we’ll prepare a 10-minute executive readout (slides + one csv export) for your leadership on Tue 13 Apr. If you want a final run at your exact payload distribution we can schedule a 30-min run on Fri 9 Apr — we’ll need a firm window and representative traces.

Links: dashboard (live) and Drive folder are linked in the footer — low-latency views and downloadable CSVs.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
attachments: benchmark_results_v1.csv, MAP_Perf_Pack_v1.pptx, ttft_concurrency_summary.pdf

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@cobalt.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cobalt.ai
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: performance artifacts (TTFT, concurrency, throughput) — packaging + exec readout

Thanks Priyom — quick questions after a first pass:

1) For the TTFT numbers, can you break out cold vs warm starts? Our traffic mix is ~30% cold (new conversations) and 70% warm.
2) The throughput section lists 420 tokens/sec — is that aggregated across model variants or for the specific quantized variant you used? We need the per-variant CSV to map to our cost forecast.
3) For concurrency, can you share the exact request-size distribution you used (percentiles by token count) so we can compare to our production traces?

Procurement: noted the MAP artifacts look good for initial review; please include a simple one-pager that calls out anything that would trigger SLA exceptions.

Can we also get the live dashboard link exported to a read-only view for my CTO?

—Ellen
Ellen Park
Head of ML Platform | Cobalt Analytics

On Thu, Apr 8, 2027 at 9:12 AM Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com> wrote:
> Per our MAP milestone for the close next week I’m attaching the initial performance artifact bundle covering the runs we discussed...

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@cobalt.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: performance artifacts (TTFT, concurrency, throughput) — packaging + exec readout

Ellen — thanks, good questions. Short answers and pointers below; I’ve attached the per-variant CSVs as well (see new file: benchmark_results_per_variant_v1.csv added to Drive).

- Cold vs warm: we ran a set of cold-start-only runs (cold cache, fresh model reload) and warm runs (hot KV cache). Cold median TTFT=420ms; warm median TTFT=120ms. The CSV includes a run_type column.
- Variant specifics: the 420 tokens/sec is for the quantized 4-bit variant we benchmarked (q4x8). The per-variant CSV has rows for fp16, q8, and q4x8.
- Request-size distribution: exported percentiles at 10/25/50/75/90/95/99 in the CSV and plotted in the Drive dashboard.

Dashboard: I created a read-only share: https://redwood.console/dashboards/ttft-DEAL-8473 (shared link). Drive folder with exports: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-MAP-artifacts

Next steps I propose:
- We do a 30-min targeted run with Cobalt payload on Fri 9 Apr 15:00–15:30 PST (we can do earlier if that slot conflicts). This will produce final CSV exports and an annotated slide deck for your execs.
- We’ll deliver a 10-minute executive readout on Tue 13 Apr — recommended attendees: CTO (Ellen), Head of Procurement (procurement@cobalt.ai), Redwood AE (Aditya), and one engineering lead.

Laura — can you prep the 10-min slide outline (2 slides summary, 1 slide risk+mitigation, 1 slide next steps) and the single-pager SLA exceptions callout?

Thanks,
Priyom

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: performance artifacts (TTFT, concurrency, throughput) — packaging + exec readout

Quick internal note — I’ve drafted the 10-minute readout outline and a one-pager for SLA exceptions. Items included:

- Slide 1: Headline metrics (median TTFT, 95th TTFT, tokens/sec at target QPS)
- Slide 2: Concurrency behavior & queuing threshold (chart + explanation)
- Slide 3: Production comparison (Cobalt trace vs Redwood run)
- Slide 4: Ask & next steps (final run, sign-off, procurement checklist)
- One-pager: clear list of conditions that would be considered SLA exceptions (sustained 95th TTFT > 500ms, error rate > 1%, sustained 30% throughput degradation for >5 minutes)

I’ll produce draft slides by EOD Mon 12 Apr and circulate for review. Priyom — confirm we still have the 13 Apr 10:00–10:30am PST readout on your calendar and that the final run (Fri 9 Apr) completed successfully.

Laura Bennett
Director, Solutions & Close | Redwood Inference

From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@cobalt.ai>

All — thanks for the quick turnaround. The final run from Fri 9 Apr looks good; distribution matches our production traces within a 3% margin on median token length. Readout on Tue 13 Apr 10:00–10:30am PST is confirmed on our side (CTO attending). Procurement — I’ll queue the MAP artifact bundle for initial review and follow up on contract language after the readout.

Please include the per-variant CSV in the HubSpot deal record for DEAL-8473 and confirm the dashboard share is read-only for cto@cobalt.ai. Once procurement gives the green light we’ll move to signature.

—Ellen
